tentoteka.title: Tentoteka
tentoteka.tagline: B2B awning catalog with CMS-driven content
tentoteka.task: The business needed a fast catalog site the marketing team could update without a developer.
tentoteka.solution: React + Vite integrated with WordPress REST API: CMS-driven content, fast client rendering and responsive layout.
tentoteka.result: Live in production: content is updated by marketing without frontend releases.
tentoteka.tech: React, TypeScript, Vite, WordPress REST API, CSS Modules

noCodeTesting.title: No-Code Testing
noCodeTesting.task: Let teams build E2E tests without writing code.
noCodeTesting.solution: Visual step builder on Canvas, Playwright under the hood and RTK Query for API work.
noCodeTesting.result: Build and dev server sped up 2x after migrating to Vite; API layer code reduced by 30% with RTK Query.
noCodeTesting.tech: Playwright, Canvas, React, RTK Query, CSS Modules, Vite
